title: An Act establishing a sick leave bank for Jessica Lynlee Ayala, an employee of the department of corrections

abstracts.abstract: By Mr. Crighton and Mr. Wong of Saugus, a joint petition (accompanied by bill) (subject to Joint Rule 12) of Brendan P. Crighton and Donald H. Wong for legislation to establish a sick leave bank for Jessica Lynlee Ayala, an employee of the department of corrections.  Public Service.
